text:
Ana: Heads up — LuminaCare CEO requested a 30m bridge at 3pm PT. They want a consolidated ask list + final POC cost numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Devin: Got it. What's the POC size and duration?
Ana: Pilot = ~10M tokens/month, 3 concurrent services, 4-week POC. They asked for guidance on Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted.
Mike: For perf we should recommend Dedicated for predictability. Quick ballpark: Dedicated gives ~30% unit cost reduction at high utilization vs hosted. I can pull perf numbers for the actual model variants.
Tara: I can run the perf harness if you give me model names and expected sequence length. Also will prepare a runbook for the bridge.
Ana: They're evaluating rwd-open-7b-quant and rwd-api-13b. Typical seq len ~1024, some longer examples to 2048.
Mike: Notes — 7b bench: p50 ~50ms single-stream; p95 ~220ms when cold, KV cache warm drops p95 to ~120ms. 13b p50 ~120ms, p95 ~480ms. These are with tokenization and prefix caching enabled.
Rachel: Legal flagged a few high-priority items in the security questionnaire: SAML SSO, EU data residency, BA/PHI boundary, retention and deletion clauses, audit rights, KMS. They want a data flow diagram and confirmation of on-prem SIEM integration.
Ana: BA is already in motion with customer legal, but they want the data flow diagram and a one-page security summary for the CEO. Can someone produce that today?
Mike: I'll sketch a lightweight dataflow diagram and call out PHI boundaries. Not a full diagram tool export, but enough for legal to review.
Tara: We can stream audit logs to their SIEM over syslog/tls. Need their collector endpoint and cert. Devin, can you get the contact?
Devin: I'll get the SIEM contact + IP allowlist today. Also need to confirm whether LuminaCare requires FIPS KMS or standard cloud KMS.
infra-bot: canary_deploy scheduled: services/poc-luminacare at 2024-03-05T22:00Z
Ana: Pricing ask — they're requesting a 3-year reserved pricing with true-up and a tiered commit schedule. Sales ops needs per-1k-token cost for 7b/13b on hosted vs dedicated.
Devin: I'm drafting the tier table. Need quick unit economics from eng for placeholders.
Mike: Quick placeholders (engineering estimate): hosted 7b = $0.0018 / 1k tokens, hosted 13b = $0.0045 / 1k. Dedicated baseline (amortized infra on high utilization) ~ $0.0012 / 1k for 7b-equivalent. Use as draft numbers until finance signs off.
Rachel: Contract language: add explicit no-data-resale clause, audit window (quarterly), KMS control for customer-managed keys, and clarify embeddings IP ownership and retention. Also add limited liability carveouts for third-party model variants.
Tara: For the POC runbook: will include canary thresholds (error rate >1% or p95 >2x baseline triggers rollback), fallback plan to hosted smaller model if Dedicated instance has perf regression, and KV cache priming steps.
Ana: Can we sync at 1pm PT today (internal) to finalize the slide and one-page security summary? CEO wants consolidated deck for the 3pm bridge.
Tara: 1pm works for me. I'll prep the runbook + rollback slides.
Mike: I'll upload perf table + KV cache strategy to the shared slide deck by 12:30.
Devin: I'll assemble pricing matrices and draft contract terms by 12:45.
Rachel: I'll produce legal checklist and a BA draft by 12:50, plus the short security summary.
Ana: Thanks team. If anything blocks, ping @here. CEO expects a single slide with ask, plus one-page security summary.
Devin: Also requesting LuminaCare's test dataset PEC guidelines and network egress destination IPs — I'll chase this.
Mike: Quick technical Q — do we need to enable prefix caching specifically for their workload? That changes memory footprint and infra sizing.
Tara: Recommended yes — prefix/KV caching reduces token cost and p95 but increases RAM for KV shards. I'll include exact memory delta in the runbook.
Ana: Great. See you at 1pm. LuminaCare bridge 3pm PT with execs.
Devin: noted, assembling contact list now.
Mike: Uploading perf logs + short notes to the deck: link will be in the 1pm invite.
Rachel: I'll circulate legal redlines after our 1pm sync.
Ana: Appreciate it all :thumbsup:
